context.person: A person using an AI travel assistant
context.user_goal: Complete passport verification and check in through the airline flow.

product_state.preceding_state: A scheduled check-in attempt failed because the airline required passport verification.
product_state.current_state: The assistant did not complete check-in. The flight reservation is unchanged.
known_facts: The assistant did not complete check-in.
The traveler can verify the passport and check in manually.
Retrying without verification will fail again.
forbidden_claims: The assistant can bypass passport verification.

current_content.title: Something went wrong
current_content.body: Open the app for more information.

challenge: Rewrite the mobile push notification so the person can understand scheduled assistant action failed, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Open the airline check-in flow and verify the passport.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Dismiss the alert without changing the reservation.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The traveler does not yet have a boarding pass.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Complete passport verification and check in through the airline flow.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
